content.text: So like Marco, you want to cigarette? No, I'm good. Thanks.
content.trans: 英语：所以像马科，你想要吸吗？不，我好。谢谢。

content.text: Okay, so that's a way of saying no thanks. No thanks. I'm okay.
content.trans: 好的，那么请告诉我您需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: Also, I'm cool. Not saying like I'm really cool. Right. It's like saying no, I'm good. I'm cool. Thanks.
content.trans: 英语：也，我很好。不是说我真的很棒。对吧。嗯，谢谢。

content.text: That's right. I'm cool. Thank you. No, thank you.
content.trans: 英语：那对，我很好。谢谢。不，谢谢。

content.text: Or as well, you can also just say no, thank you.
content.trans: 英语：或者，你也可以只是说不，谢谢。

content.text: I think the most clear is no, I don't smoke or no, I don't do drugs.
content.trans: 我感觉最清晰的是不，我不吸烟也不吸毒。

content.text: Yes. Exactly. That's the verb that we use when referring to drugs. You do drugs. You don't do drugs.
content.trans: 是的。正好。当我们谈论毒品时，我们使用“做毒品”的这个动词。你吸毒吗？你不吸毒吗？

content.text: So he does drugs or don't do drugs. You often hear this phrase.
content.trans: 所以他吸毒或者不吸毒。你经常听到这句话。

content.text: So you can say, listen, no, no, thank you. I'm cool. I don't do drugs.
content.trans: 英语：所以你可以这么说，听我说，不，不，谢谢。我好好的。我没有吸毒。

content.text: That's right. So as we said, this is all the kind of street slang or colloquial, very common ways of referring to drugs in English.
content.trans: 英语：那对，所以我们说这是所有这种街头俚语或口语化的表达方式的全部。

content.text: So you can keep an eye out for that if you hear that in movies.
content.trans: 所以，如果你在电影中听到那个声音，你就可以保持警觉了。

content.text: Now, you know more or less what they're referring to. And also, of course, if you have any questions, any comments or any suggestions, we are always available on our website, Englishpa.com.
content.trans: 现在，你了解他们大概的意思。而且，当然，如果你有任何问题、建议或意见，请随时联系我们网站：https://www.englishpa.com/。

content.text: We hope to see you guys there. And until next time, bye.
content.trans: 我们希望见到你们。下一次再见，祝好！

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 再见。
